# Sunbrilo Technologies

> Sunbrilo Technologies is an IT solutions provider offering a comprehensive suite of services — including software development, data analytics, cloud, cybersecurity, and managed IT — alongside a portfolio of industry-specific software solutions (HRMS, order management, logistics, CMMS, and more). The company has offices in India (Pune), the USA (Delaware), and the UK (London).

## Company

- [Home](https://sunbrilotechnologies.com/): Overview of Sunbrilo Technologies, its services, solutions, and value proposition.
- [About Us](https://sunbrilotechnologies.com/aboutus): Company background, mission, and team information.
- [Contact Us](https://sunbrilotechnologies.com/contact-us): Contact details and office locations (India, USA, UK).
- [Career](https://sunbrilotechnologies.com/career): Job openings and career opportunities at Sunbrilo Technologies.

## Services

- [Services Overview](https://sunbrilotechnologies.com/services): Summary of all technology services offered.
- [Development & Testing](https://sunbrilotechnologies.com/services/development-testing): Tailored software development and thorough testing for quality and scalability.
- [Data Analytics](https://sunbrilotechnologies.com/services/data-analytics): AI-powered insights that turn raw data into actionable business intelligence.
- [Offshoring Services](https://sunbrilotechnologies.com/services/offshoring-services): Cost-effective offshore delivery using global talent.
- [Implementation Services](https://sunbrilotechnologies.com/services/implementation-services): IT project implementation and seamless system integration.
- [Managed IT Services](https://sunbrilotechnologies.com/services/managed-it-services): End-to-end IT management to ensure smooth operations and minimize downtime.
- [Cybersecurity](https://sunbrilotechnologies.com/services/cybersecurity): Advanced solutions to safeguard systems from cyber threats and ensure compliance.
- [Cloud Solutions](https://sunbrilotechnologies.com/services/cloud-solutions): Scalable, secure cloud services for long-term cost reduction.
- [Monitoring and Support](https://sunbrilotechnologies.com/services/monitoring-and-support): 24/7 monitoring and support to keep systems secure and accessible.

## Solutions

- [Solutions Overview](https://sunbrilotechnologies.com/solutions): Summary of industry-specific software solutions offered.
- [Cognitive Dining & Workforce Orchestration](https://sunbrilotechnologies.com/solutions/cognitive-dining-workforce-orchestration): Smart cafeteria operations with digital menus, pre-ordering, dietary tracking, and waste analytics.
- [Logistics & Supply Chain Solutions](https://sunbrilotechnologies.com/solutions/logistic-and-supply-chain-solutions): Real-time tracking, demand forecasting, and route optimization.
- [Equipment Leasing Platform](https://sunbrilotechnologies.com/solutions/equipment-leasing-platform): Platform to manage equipment leasing operations efficiently.
- [HRMS: Empowering Your Workforce](https://sunbrilotechnologies.com/solutions/hrms-empowering-your-workforce): Payroll automation, attendance tracking, performance reviews, and talent development.
- [Order Management](https://sunbrilotechnologies.com/solutions/order-management): AI-driven order management software for zero-latency fulfillment.
- [Remote Geofencing Attendance System](https://sunbrilotechnologies.com/solutions/remote-geofencing-attendance-system): Accurate remote workforce attendance tracking using geofencing technology.
- [Intelligent Asset Performance Management](https://sunbrilotechnologies.com/solutions/intelligent-asset-performance-management): CMMS tools for failure prediction, preventive maintenance, and asset lifecycle extension.
- [Tablet-Based Biometric Attendance System](https://sunbrilotechnologies.com/solutions/tablet-based-biometric-attendance-system): Reliable, secure tablet-based biometric attendance tracking.
